title: Deep learning for medical image segmentation
abstract: We apply convolutional neural networks CNN to segment organs in medical images. The segmentation model is trained on labelled scans.

title: Transformer models for time series anomaly detection
abstract: A transformer architecture is used to detect anomalies in multivariate time series from industrial sensors.

title: UAV navigation in GPS denied environments using sensor fusion
abstract: We fuse inertial and visual sensors to navigate an unmanned aerial vehicle UAV when GPS is unavailable.

title: A CNN approach to image classification
abstract: A convolutional neural network CNN classifies natural images into object categories. Classification accuracy is reported on a benchmark.

title: CNN and transformer hybrid for semantic segmentation
abstract: We combine a CNN encoder with a transformer decoder for segmentation of street scenes.

title: Medical image classification with deep neural networks
abstract: Deep neural networks classify chest X-ray images into disease categories; classification performance is compared with radiologists.

title: Anomaly detection in time series using autoencoders
abstract: Autoencoders learn normal patterns in time series and flag deviations as anomalies.

title: Visual odometry for drones without GPS
abstract: A monocular camera provides visual odometry for small drones flying where GPS signals are denied.

title: Transformer language models for text summarization
abstract: Transformer based language models are fine tuned for abstractive text summarization of news articles.

title: Segmentation of brain tumours in MRI using U-Net
abstract: A U-Net convolutional network segments brain tumours in MRI scans for medical image analysis.

title: Kalman filter sensor fusion for vehicle localisation
abstract: An extended Kalman filter fuses wheel odometry and lidar to localise ground vehicles.

title: Query processing in relational database systems
abstract: We study how relational databases execute text queries and compare LIKE scans with indexes.

title: Inverted indexes for efficient information retrieval
abstract: Inverted indexes map each term to a posting list of documents; TF-IDF ranking orders results by relevance.

title: Deep reinforcement learning for robot control
abstract: A policy network is trained with reinforcement learning to control a robot arm.
